BRXkpX6jclh.caption:
Impressions after one week of owning a Japanese Series 2:

Hardware: SO MUCH SNAPPIER than my Series 0. Everything runs at a constant 60FPS. So good.

Suica: Absolutely amazing. Works great with my US Apple Pay account. I've only had to physically touch cash like twice on this trip. Totally worth it for the 14 days I'm here. XD

Ceramic: They had me at 'virtually scratchproof'. XD It's very heavy and only looks nice with the Sport or Leather Loop bands, so I'm not sure if I can recommend it. But since I prefer the red Sports band and hate scratched hardware, I love it. :D

All in all: a perfect 5/7.
